items.title: Jon-Erik Kellso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: was Benny Goodman and Harry James and Count Basie, which I love that stuff

ctx.x: Wow, that’s a good place to start.

Yeah, exactly. And I have to admit, when I first heard it I kind of didn’t know what to make of it because really the only stuff I was familiar with at that point, that being fifth grade you know, was Benny Goodman and Harry James and Count Basie, which I love that stuff. And to hear this at first I hadn’t heard anything that old at all of anything. And so the surface noise it was kind of a bad LP copy of it, it was a little bit of work to listen to but I knew it was hitting me hard. I mean I knew that this music…

Yeah. It’s hard to get past that kind of limited technology that they were using at the time, but it still sounds funny to hear you say that being in fifth grade I was only familiar with Benny Goodman, you know?
